messages:
emma: Heads up - Orion Health just replied: legal needs SOC 2 plus an evidence bundle under NDA before we can run HI data in the POC. They asked for a short bridge statement while reviews happen. Meeting in the morning. Can we turn this around quickly? @rafael @li

rafael: We have the SOC 2 Type II report. Quick question: do they want the auditor's notes included? We should avoid sharing raw audit working docs.

li: We typically share the final report PDF (redacted for auditor internal comments), a controls mapping spreadsheet, and a curated evidence set in S3. Rules: NDA first, presigned URLs (7d), explicit file manifest so we don't leak any PII or internal secrets.

john: Legal asked if we can provide an "ops attestation" instead of a bridge letter. Ops attestation template says we maintain SOC 2 Type II for security & availability and that the report is available to authorized reviewers under NDA. It's not an auditor opinion. That should be acceptable to most vendor risk teams.

emma: Customer insisted on the ability to inspect some logs/configs. Security: what's safe to expose?

li: Safe set = config snapshots, redacted service access logs (anonymized IDs), monitoring dashboards, and a README + manifest. Do NOT include KV cache dumps or full core dumps. We must anonymize internal IPs and strip user identifiers.

rafael: I'll prep the bundle and a manifest (README + md5). ETA 24h after legal signs off NDA language.

legal-bot: NDA-template v2.1 uploaded. Includes clause EVID-S3-2026: scoped S3 prefixes, 7-day presigned URL expiry, no redistribution, and mandatory deletion within 30 days.

john: I'll send the lean NDA via DocuSign with EVID-S3-2026. Also attaching the ops attestation copy.

emma: Workflow to confirm with customer: 1) Sign NDA via DocuSign 2) We send ops attestation + presigned S3 bundle (7d) 3) One 30-60 min follow-up Q&A. Will that satisfy them?

rafael: Yes. I'll stage the bundle once DocuSign completes and then trigger presigned-url job.

li: Note to POC owner - redact IPs and remove any customer identifiers before upload. I'll review the file manifest before presign.

emma: Great, I'll update the customer and book the follow-up. Thanks all.
